note: Non-urn `grantId` — HCP grant identifiers are urn:uuid.
Missing `accessToken` — the Management Client's token is the evidence of the person's authority.
Missing `grantId` — a revocation names the grant it ends.
Unknown top-level request member — HCP's revoke takes no reason or other member.
A member in the revoke response — HCP answers 204 No Content, so the payload is the empty object.
A response that says the grant was already revoked — revoking an already-revoked grant succeeds with the same empty object, so the answer never tells the two apart.
